responsibility: Defines the Xtensa backend’s machine constraints used by reload, register allocation, and instruction recognition. It assigns register classes and immediate or memory forms to constraint letters, including ABI- and option-dependent register sets, literal-pool versus non-literal memory forms, and immediates tailored to Xtensa instruction encodings such as MOVI, ADDI, ADDMI, branches, and EXTUI, so that patterns in xtensa.md can describe exactly which operands the target can encode.
